description: Optional Baserow mirror of the challenge catalogue. The bundled seed in src/app/config/challenge-catalogue.seed.ts is the source of truth. Import TWENTY-FIFTH (no dependencies)
notes: THE CODE IS AUTHORITATIVE, NOT THIS TABLE. Level values drive PERMANENT awards, so the catalogue is version-pinned in the app bundle where it can be code-reviewed. This table exists for editing copy and for previewing new challenges, not for changing payouts behind a release.
tiers_json holds the per-difficulty rules as JSON: {"easy":{...},"medium":{...},"hard":{...}} with levelValue, targetPerPeriod, requiredPassRate, graceMisses and blurb.
A run FREEZES its tier's levelValue into its own terms at start time, so editing a value here never changes what an in-flight run pays out.
allows_partner stays false until partnered challenges ship.

base_level_value.description: Fallback when a tier omits its own levelValue
